correctness.rationale: Traces on A_i and B_i are self-singletons plus the opposite selected side excluding the same index. Distinct same-side traces require <=1 index wholly unselected; cross-side collisions then force <=2 occupied indices and are impossible for n>=4. Coverage disallows precisely six disjoint boundary classes, giving the bivariate and univariate formulas. For n>=5 the minimum n-1 and count n(2^(n-1)-2n) follow by choosing a missing index and >=2 vertices on each side; n=4 has 56 size-four codes. Independently enumerated all 2^(2n) vertex subsets for n=4,5,6; exact bivariate distributions agree.
